# CDHIT output evaluation

## v3 changes
* similar to treecluster_eval_v3:
* n clusters,mean and median size changed to not include singletons
* make versions of eval plots that do not have legends (composite only has one legend) and additional plot for median
* move composite plot inside and with seg_leg

## Objectives
* Read in the clstr txt file to parse the clusters, members, size, percentage sim
* Compare the different cutoffs and word lengths
* PLot the clusters from CD-HIT on tips of best tree

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(NatParksPalettes)
library(cowplot)
```

#Ins and Outs
```{r}
files.in<-list.files("cdhit_out_g1/",pattern=".fasta.clstr", full.names = T)

f.out<-paste0(Sys.Date(), "_g1_eval_out/")
if(!dir.exists(f.out)){dir.create(f.out)}

#plotting theme
plot.theme<-theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                  panel.background = element_rect("grey95"), 
                  axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
                  text=element_text(size=10,face="bold"),
                  legend.text=element_text(size=8),
                  axis.text.x=element_text(angle = 45,hjust=1,vjust=1))
```

## Loop over all files, plot results, extract a summary table 
```{r}
#Empty list to hold the files
l.f<-length(files.in)
summ.list<-replicate(n=l.f, vector())

i=1
for (i in 1:l.f){
  
  file.in<-files.in[i]
  # file.in<-"cdhit_HA_97_w11.fasta.clstr"
  
  cd <- read.table(file.in, header = FALSE, sep = "\n")
  params<-str_extract(file.in, paste0("(?<=", "\\/cdhit_", ").*?(?=", "\\.fasta", ")"))
  
  #also what is the segment and percetn identity?
  seg<-str_split(params,"_") %>% unlist() %>% first()
  perc<-(str_split(params,"_") %>% unlist())[2]
  # perc<-str_split(params,"_") %>% unlist() %>% last() #for non G1
  #Separate out the > cluster rows and ascribe those as cluster column
  # Construct the regex pattern using positive lookbehind (?<=...) and positive lookahead (?=...)
  # The (.*?) part captures any characters non-greedily between the patterns
  cd$nucname <- str_extract(cd$V1, paste0("(?<=", "\\>", ").*?(?=", "\\.\\.\\.", ")"))
  cd$percent <- str_extract(cd$V1, paste0("(?<=", "\\+\\/", ").*?(?=", "\\%", ")"))
  cd$length <- str_extract(cd$V1, paste0("(?<=", "\\\t", ").*?(?=", "nt,", ")"))
  
  #Find cluster and assign to relevant rows as new column
  clustrows<-str_which(cd$V1, "Cluster")
  cd$cluster<-NA
  for (j in 1:length(clustrows)){
    max<-(clustrows[j+1]-1) #this will be the last/max row to assign cluster unless...
    if(j==length(clustrows)){max<-nrow(cd)} #unless it is the last i, then goes to maxrow
    cd$cluster[clustrows[j]:max]<-str_remove(cd$V1[clustrows[j]], "\\>")
  }
  
  #now remove the cluster rows
  cd<-cd[-clustrows, ] %>% select (-V1)
  cd$params<-params #for future ref
  cd$seg<-seg
  cd$perc<-perc
  
  #make a dpercent#make a df of unique clusters, cluster size
  cd.cl<-cd %>% group_by(cluster) %>% 
    summarize(.groups="rowwise",
              size=n())
  cd.cl<-cd.cl[order(cd.cl$size, decreasing = T),]
  clust.ord<-cd.cl$cluster
  cd.cl$cluster<-factor(cd.cl$cluster, levels=clust.ord)
  cd.cl$params<-params #for future ref
  cd.cl$seg<-seg
  cd.cl$perc<-perc
  
  #Summarize entire cdhit run
  cd.cl.summ<-as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(summary(cd.cl$size))))
  cd.cl.summ$n.clusters<-nrow(cd.cl)
  cd.cl.summ$n.singles<-length(which(cd.cl$size ==1))
  cd.cl.summ$min.no.sing=min(cd.cl$size[which(cd.cl$size!=1)])
  cd.cl.summ$sd=sd(cd.cl$size)
  cd.cl.summ$params<-params
  cd.cl.summ$seg<-seg
  cd.cl.summ$perc<-perc
  cd.cl.summ <- cd.cl.summ %>% 
    mutate( #include no singles metrics
      ratio.max.min = Max. / min.no.sing,
      n.clusters.nosing = n.clusters - n.singles,
      mean.nosing = mean(cd.cl$size[which(cd.cl$size != 1)]),
      median.nosing = median(cd.cl$size[which(cd.cl$size != 1)]) )
  summ.list[[i]]<-cd.cl.summ
  
  key.features<-paste0("CD-HIT min. % similarity: ",perc,
                       "\nN clusters: ",cd.cl.summ$n.clusters.nosing[1],
                       "\nN singles: ",cd.cl.summ$n.singles[1],
                       "\nMax size: ", cd.cl.summ$Max.[1],
                       "\nMean size: ", sprintf("%.1f",cd.cl.summ$mean.nosing[1]),
                       "\nMedian size: ", cd.cl.summ$median.nosing[1])
  
  ## plot LOG cluster sizes and annotate run with key features
  cd.cl %>%
    filter(size!=1) %>%
    ggplot()+
      geom_bar(aes(x=cluster,y=log10(size), fill=cluster),stat="identity")+
      scale_fill_viridis_d(option="D")+
      labs(x="Cluster",y="Log10 (cluster size)")+
      ggtitle(paste0("CD-HIT: ",seg))+
      annotate(geom="label",x=cd.cl.summ$n.clusters.nosing*0.5, 
               y=log(cd.cl.summ$Max.), hjust=0, vjust=1, label=key.features)+
      plot.theme+
      theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x=element_blank())
  ggsave(paste0(f.out, "logclustsize_",params,".tiff"), height=3, width=5, units="in")
  
  #write cd to use for cluster identity
  write.csv(cd, paste0(f.out, "cd-out_",params,".csv"))
  
  #write cd to use for cluster chars
  write.csv(cd.cl, paste0(f.out, "cd-cl-out_",params,".csv"))
} #end of loop across all the cluster files (outputs from cdhit for diff params)
```

## plot summ list by segment 
```{r}
# segment colors
segments<-c("PB2","PB1","PA","HA","NP","NA","M","NS")
segment.cols<-natparks.pals(name="Yellowstone", n=length(segments))
segment.cols<-segment.cols[c(1,5,2,4,6,3,8,7)]
names(segment.cols)<-segments

## join all the elems into one df
cd.cl.summ.all<-bind_rows(summ.list)
cd.cl.summ.all<-cd.cl.summ.all %>% mutate(max.min.ratio = Max. / min.no.sing, remove=F)
cd.cl.summ.all$seg<-factor(cd.cl.summ.all$seg, levels=segments)
cd.cl.summ.all$perc<-as.numeric(cd.cl.summ.all$perc) 
```

# Comparison plots
```{r}
#plot by segment: n cluster
cd.cl.summ.all %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=perc, y=n.clusters.nosing, group=seg, color=seg)) +
  geom_point()+
  # geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = F, linewidth = )+
  scale_color_manual(values=segment.cols)+
  plot.theme+
  labs(x="CD-HIT min. % similarity", y="N clusters", color="Segment")+
  theme(legend.position = "top")
ggsave(paste0(f.out, "percentID_vs_Ncluster.nosing.tiff"),height=4,width=4)

#plot by segment: n singles
cd.cl.summ.all %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(aes(x=perc, y=n.singles, group=seg, color=seg))+
  scale_color_manual(values=segment.cols)+
  plot.theme+
  labs(x="CD-HIT minimum % similarity", y="N singletons", color="Segment")+
  theme(legend.position = "top")

#plot by segment: max size

#plot by segment: max size

#plot by segment: max/min ratio

  ggplot() +

  scale_color_manual(values=segment.cols)+

  theme(legend.position = "top")
ggsave(paste0(f.out, "percentID_vs_maxminratio.tiff"),height=4,width=4)
```

# Comparison plots
```{r}
#plot by segment: n cluster
p1<-cd.cl.summ.all %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=perc, y=n.clusters.nosing, group=seg, color=seg)) +
  geom_point()+
  # geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = F, linewidth = )+
  scale_color_manual(values=segment.cols)+
  plot.theme+
  labs(x="CD-HIT minimum % similarity", y="N clusters (excl. singletons)", color="Segment")+
  theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave(plot=p1,paste0(f.out, "percentID_vs_Ncluster.nosing_noleg.tiff"),height=3,width=4)

#plot by segment: n singles

#plot by segment: max size

## LEGEND ONLY
plot_legend <- get_legend(p4+
                            theme(legend.position = "top")+
                            guides(color=guide_legend(nrow=1)))

ggsave(filename = paste0(f.out,"seg_leg.tiff"),
  plot = ggdraw(plot_legend), 
  width = 8, 
  height = 0.25, 
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300)
```

#composite plot 
```{r}
row1<-plot_grid(p1, p2, ncol=2,nrow=1, labels=c("A","B"),label_size = 16, align="hv")
row2<-plot_grid(p3,p4, ncol=2,nrow=1, labels=c("C","D"),label_size = 16, align="hv")
full_plot<-plot_grid(plot_legend, row1, row2, ncol=1, nrow=3,
                     rel_heights = c(0.25,3,3), rel_widths = c(1,1,1),
                     labels=NULL)

ggsave(plot = full_plot,filename = paste0(f.out, "cdhit_composite_size_vs_thresh.tiff"),
       width=8,height=6.25,bg="white")
```
